prompt:

Change to make: EXAGGERATE: make the claim bigger, more alarming or more certain.

Message: "The council is launching an aggressive crackdown and will be slapping us with massive fines for leaving bins out even for a second. They’re finally turning our street into a police state just to enforce their ridiculous new rules."
text: I heard the council is officially weaponizing surveillance to hunt down every single bin left out, so expect massive fines to start hitting our doors any minute now. They are completely turning our neighborhood into a total police state over these trash cans!
